description: Small feature: remove stock with validation.
objective: Add a method remove(name, qty) to Inventory in inventory.py. It decreases the stock of name by qty and returns the remaining quantity; when the remaining quantity is 0 the item is dropped from the inventory. It raises ValueError if qty is not a positive integer, and KeyError if the item is unknown. If there is not enough stock it raises ValueError and leaves the stock unchanged. Add tests for it in tests/.
